title: api-changelog-tracker
offersHint: Cloudflare Workers MCP server: api-changelog-tracker · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.lazy-mac.com/api-changelog-tracker/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_tracked_apis
toolsPreview.description: List all tracked APIs with metadata and latest changelog status. Filter by category (ai, payments, developer-tools, communications, infrastructure, email).

toolsPreview.name: fetch_changelog
toolsPreview.description: Fetch versioned changelog entries for a specific API (openai, anthropic, stripe, github, twilio, cloudflare, sendgrid, slack). Filter by date and breaking-only.

toolsPreview.name: diff_versions
toolsPreview.description: Compare changelog state between two dates for an API. Shows what was added or removed in the range.

toolsPreview.name: detect_breaking_changes
toolsPreview.description: Detect breaking changes across one or multiple APIs. Filter by severity (critical, high, medium, low) and date. Omit api_id to scan all APIs.

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across all changelog entries. Searches title, summary, and change descriptions.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_feed
toolsPreview.description: Register a webhook or email to receive changelog update notifications. Returns a subscription ID.
